line: My candle burns at both ends. It will not last the night.
credit: Edna St. Vincent Millay · First Fig, 1918

line: Candy gave energy, but briefly. An hour later, people felt more tired.
credit: Robert Thayer · J Pers Soc Psychol, 1987

line: Old marathon records: fast start, then slowing. Since 1988: a steadier pace.
credit: Díaz et al. · Eur J Sport Sci, 2018

line: A thin stream flows long: use a little at a time.
A bow always kept bent soon breaks. Loosen it, and it's ready.
After little sleep, a 10-minute nap made people more alert right away.
Yogis count life in breaths, not days, and breathe slow and deep.
credit: B. K. S. Iyengar · Light on Yoga, 1966

line: Breathe with the three bandhas in asana. The mind follows the breath.
credit: K. Pattabhi Jois · Yoga Mala, Pranayama
